description: Compact footer of the 2026 Get a Demo pages (live #ap-demo-footer): logo and copyright left; app-store badges, address, legal links and social icons right. behaviour.js moves it into the global footer, whose CTA band and link columns this page hides. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
